Compiler cli

Introduction

In order to facilitate the development of CI/CD more flexibly, we provide the independent compiler cli in addition to the IDE internal integration.

Obtained by

Heading for Plugin download pageDownload the compiler package Macle_xx.x.x_Engine_Compiler.zip.

Decompress the Macle_xx.x.x_Engine_Compiler.zip package and go to the directory. Run the npm i -g command.

Usage Mode

Parameter

Name Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
-s String Yes. Directory of Mini Program source code
-t String Yes. Target directory after Mini Program compilation
-d Boolean false No Indicates whether the debug mode is used.
-es5 Boolean false No Transfer to ES5
-mss Number 2 No Maximum size of a single package/primary package (unit: MB)
-mts Number 20 No Maximum package size (unit: MB)

Example

macle-compiler-cli -s D:/workspace/MiniProgram/Src/macle-web/demo/macle -t D:/workspace/MiniProgram/Src/macle-web/simulator/sdk/root/app

F&Qs

Why the console method and debugger in the Mini Program do not take effect when the independent compiler provided by Macle is used to run the Mini Program packages?

A: To help developers compile Mini Programs in command line mode, Macle provides an independent compiler. By default, the compiler filters the console and debugger in the code. Currently, the filtering policy cannot be configured by developers.
